home.architecture.description: Each axis is replaceable on its own, and the scheduler core stays the same.
home.architecture.immutable: use() returns a new definition. Existing definitions, and the schedulers created from them, stay untouched.
home.architecture.title: Model. Time. Policy. Independently composed.
home.contributors.description: Models, middleware, and improvements across the project benefit from ideas and contributions shared through community pull requests.
home.contributors.title: Built in the open.
home.cta.description: The default scheduler covers common cases. When your requirements call for it, compose your own with a different model, chrono, or middleware.
home.cta.title: Start with FSRS. Build beyond it.
home.ecosystem.binding: Parameter training, evaluation, and review-log conversion, for when you outgrow the default weights.
home.entry.compose.body: Pick a model and a chrono, then add the policies your product needs, one middleware at a time.
home.entry.compose.title: Compose
home.entry.description: Use the default FSRS scheduler, compose your own scheduling policy, or implement an entirely new model — all on the same core.
home.entry.extend.body: Write your own middleware, chrono, or model when the built-ins run out.
home.entry.extend.title: Extend
home.entry.title: Start simple. Extend without starting over.
home.entry.use.body: DefaultScheduler provides an FSRS scheduler with sensible defaults. It supports FSRS-3 through FSRS-6 and defaults to FSRS-6.
home.entry.use.title: Use
home.middleware.builtin.desiredRetention: Passes the configured retention target into interval calculation.
home.middleware.builtin.fuzzing: Applies deterministic interval variation, seeded by card ID and review count.
home.middleware.builtin.learningSteps: Schedules learning and relearning steps in minutes, hours, or days.
home.middleware.builtin.leech: Suspends a card whenever its lapse count reaches a multiple of the configured threshold.
home.middleware.builtin.maximumInterval: Clamps the final schedule to the configured maximum.
home.middleware.builtin.monotonicInterva: Keeps higher ratings from producing shorter schedules.
home.middleware.builtin.scheduledDays: Stores the final whole-day interval on cards and review logs.
home.middleware.builtin.stats: Adds and maintains the reps and lapses counters on cards.
home.middleware.title: Scheduling behavior, ready to compose.
home.perf.description: The API is designed around lazy evaluation, code splitting, and immutable results.
home.perf.immutable.body: Reviews return new cards; nothing in the input is mutated.
home.perf.immutable.title: Immutable results
home.perf.lazyPreview.body: preview() only schedules the grades you actually iterate.
home.perf.lazyPreview.title: Lazy preview
home.perf.lazySchema.body: Composed schemas are built on first access, not when the definition is declared.
home.perf.lazySchema.title: Lazy composition
home.perf.rollback.body: rollback() restores the previous card from its revlog, middleware fields included.
home.perf.rollback.title: Reversible reviews
home.perf.split.body: DefaultScheduler loads the selected FSRS version on demand, helping keep unused model code out of the initial load.
home.perf.split.title: Version-based code splitting
home.perf.title: Performance is part of the architecture.
home.perf.treeShaking.body: sideEffects is false, and models and middleware ship as subpath exports.
home.perf.treeShaking.title: Tree-shakable exports
home.schema.description: Standard Schema provides a shared runtime-validation and type contract for configuration, cards, review logs, memory state, and time values.
home.schema.point.mutability: Input cards stay readonly; only the scheduled result is mutable.
home.schema.point.source: A single schema validates at runtime and infers the TypeScript types, so the two can never drift apart.
home.schema.point.status: Fields and statuses that middleware adds appear in the inferred types automatically.
home.schema.title: One contract. End-to-end types.
home.sponsors.description: Every sponsorship helps sustain ts-fsrs maintenance and its ongoing alignment with FSRS research.
home.sponsors.title: Thank you for every bit of support.
